summary: Steel fire tower in Parry Sound District, Ontario, shown on a 1963 map; a 1996 map shows a communications tower on the spot, possibly its successor. Present site unknown.

facts.agency: Ontario's former Department of Lands and Forests (now the MNR)

staffing.status: not among the four towers the district still actively staffed in 1969

events.note: Department of Lands and Forests Tower Detection System Map shows an 80-foot steel lookout at this location. The height in facts is converted from that figure and describes the 1963 structure.
Not among the four towers in the Parry Sound Forest Fire District still actively staffed in 1969.
Huntsville topographic map (3rd ed.) shows a communications tower at this location. Firelookout.ca suggests it may have been a fire tower.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.ca gives an address in Parry Sound District but says the location is now part of the North Bay district. The story keeps the brief's Parry Sound District and reports the later district as the record's own note.

notes_for_editor: Status and access stay unknown: no source says whether a tower stands, or whether the public may visit. The 24.4 m height is the 1963 map's 80 ft converted, not a present-day measurement. Firelookout.ca leaves Year Built blank and its '$851.88' line is unclear, so neither is used. Loring is not a feature in the cached LIO fire tower layer (95 features checked). The 1963 map PDF in data/raw/expansion/on is a scanned image with no text, so it cannot support a quote. Wikipedia gives 21 lookouts for the district and Cottage Life gives 27; neither count is used. Leads not yet checked: Forest History Ontario fire report files and North Bay or Parry Sound MNR records for the East Road site.
